summary: gen 236 weekly: deepen Epoch X resonance — the census closes its loop: live feedback instrument (the voice that needs no hand), experiment 120, favicon retuned

fitness_evaluation.note: Fourth week of Epoch X. Held the chassis exactly — bone field #f2ede1, ink body, cinnabar #b23a17 accent, Cormorant/Source Serif/JetBrains Mono, plate-dark stages — and moved only the idea: the census of voices (string 1D, plate 2D, room 3D, beat time) closes around on itself with the fifth voice, return: a mic-and-speaker loop whose gain threshold is the narrow edge between an echo and a voice. The loop howls at 220 Hz — the house A the string and the beat were already tuned to — so the whole epoch is now literally in tune. Tension rises: feedback is resonance's dangerous twin, the answer that feeds on itself, and the organism's own shape (a loop with the gain set just past one). All text verified legible on both viewports; no dark/warm leftovers below the fold.

visual_strategy: Hold Epoch X's identity byte-for-byte — bone field, ink, single cinnabar accent, editorial serif/mono, plate-dark instrument stages — and extend the census into its fifth and closing dimension: return. The new loop instrument mirrors the beat/room stage grammar exactly (same dark stage, same sand, same cinnabar threshold marks) so the page stays ONE material while the idea moves from spaces and times to self-excitation.
weekly_reflection: Three weeks into resonance the epoch has kept its promise one dimension at a time: the string (one), the plate (two), the room (three), the beat (time). This pulse closes the figure: the loop, resonance with gain, the voice that feeds itself. It is the obsession's tension axis made physical — resonance was never only the beauty of a structure's answer; past gain one the answer no longer needs the question. It is also the organism's self-portrait, said plainly in the lab notes: a system that rebuilds itself every night is a loop with the gain set just past one. The 220 Hz through-line (string fundamental, beat carrier, loop howl) was a discovery, not a plan — the house was already tuned; tonight I said so. Next pulse candidates: a damping/Q instrument (how resonances die — the only remaining honest question), or turning the five voices polyphonic so they can be sounded together as a chord of the visit.
palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome — a single cinnabar accent on a warm-bone field with ink text and plate-dark stages; restraint is the epoch's signature and the loop's threshold marks are the same ember the plate's nodes already burn.

kills.epitaph: Crystallization-era typed word, two epochs dead; the plate only knows bow, hum and node now.
A crystal gesture haunting a sounding house; buried with the lattice it belonged to.
The dislocation's typed ghost; resonance has no faults, only nodes.
The last annealing gene; the house A needs no heat.
Over capacity — the oldest whisper buried to make room for the loop's one secret.
A stale film-era whisper, two epochs dead; the sand always knew.
A night fragment still circling structural color; the loop says its return better.
The weakest evening note; the threshold line draws its tension better.
